S0.rot: own motor per root, any angle
S0.curl: own winch per finger (8 static drivers)
S0.risk: many interfaces; keys must find the slots

S1.t:
Every motor rides its root
(no static drivers)
S1.rot: own motor per root, any angle
S1.curl: own motor on each winch screw
S1.risk: +38 g spinning at r ~36: 611 N more per leg (now ~200 N)
S1.verdict: KILL as is: leg needs ~3x section

S2.t:
S1 + one board on the rotor,
3-pin dock at park
S2.rot: own motor per root, any angle
S2.curl: own motor on each winch screw
S2.contacts: 3 pogo pins at one spot + 4 flex loops in the hub
S2.risk: electronics and flex loops at 12,500 rpm (3,600 g at r 20)

S3.t:
Cam sleeve: one screw
moves all roots to presets
S3.rot: presets only (cross / 3+1 / 2+2 / one side), all at once
S3.curl: own winch per finger (8 static drivers)
S3.risk: not free angles; slot wear; order of presets fixed

S4.t:
Cam sleeve + v3 single
pull-ring curl
S4.risk: gives up independent curl and free angles

S5.t:
S1 but rotation only
(v3 pull-ring curl back)
S5.rot: own motor per root, any angle
S5.contacts: KILL: yokes fill the space under the rim (see rotation study)
S5.risk: no room for tracks / legs under the v3 yokes
